notes.title: Patch v1.0.1: Now Easier to Quit on Steam Deck – Plus a Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for playing [i]Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+[/i]![/p][p]In this update we have added improvements for the users on Steam Deck to be able to exit the game easier! We also fixed the Steam achievements bug as well![/p][p][/p][p]·       You can now press the “View” button on the Steam Deck at the Title Screen to bring up the option to exit the game[/p][p]·       You can now press the B-button at the Home Screen to go back to the Title Screen on the Steam Deck[/p][p]·       Fixed a bug where the final achievement in Steam would not unlock under certain conditions[/p][p][/p][p]We thank the users for their valuable feedback![/p][p]Hope you continue to enjoy the game!
[/p]

notes.title: “Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+” is out now!
notes.notes:
Step into the world of puzzles with Hatsune Miku and the Piapro Characters!
Solve puzzles to collect stunning artwork, catchy songs, and stylish costumes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/797e02fcc6afe0766eeb40a5ca5492af5a96b687.jpg[/img]

[h2]Over 1,000 puzzles included![/h2]

From classic sizes like 10x10, 15x15, and 20x20, giant linked puzzles that come together as one big picture― Every puzzle you solve reveals new illustrations to decorate your room!

Create a beautiful space for Miku and the Piapro characters to hang out, just the way you like it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/a0f3176ac9ef5b55cc65a21effc031b5c5639a95.jpg[/img]

Solve, collect, and have even more fun with Miku!

[b]Clear puzzles to unlock:[/b]
[list]
[*] Collect adorable illustrations!
[*] Unlock songs featuring Hatsune Miku and the Piapro characters!
[*] Character costumes for Miku, and Piapro characters―mix and match your favorite looks!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/ac116268d49bb58ab7b63ff0aabf233073d2e0d6.jpg[/img]

And that’s not all! Join our special giveaway event—open until July 31st (PST) —for a chance to win a 1/7 scale “Hatsune Miku: Beauty Looking Back Ver.” figure or a limited-edition acrylic block!

Don’t miss your chance to join and grab some exclusive Miku goodies!
